descriptionPlain:
Motif is building an agent-native BIM platform for architects. We need a technical content creator who understands architecture and BIM well enough to make product videos and supporting content that architects trust. You'll own the core product story: building the models, recording the demos, and producing the videos our sales and social channels run on. You'll work closely with our marketing team, and a video editor will handle the social layer (cuts, music, platform polish) from your finished clips.
 
This is a 3-month contract engagement with possibility to extend.

lists.content:
• Build the models and record the product clips that demonstrate Motif's capabilities
  • Produce high-quality demo videos and sales assets that show real architectural workflows
  • Create short videos (1-2 minutes) that tell a clear story to people who are new to the product
  • Hand off finished clips to our social video editor
  • Turn around more video and visual assets, faster, as sales and social needs grow

    •

• Deep architecture/AEC domain knowledge. You know how architects work and what they care about
  • Strong BIM understanding
  • Storytelling instinct for short-form product video
  • Video production experience
  • A portfolio or work samples we can review

    •

lists.text: It would be great if you had
lists.content: • Any specific editing tool. We care about the output, not your software stack
